content.short: NFT Explorer is a demo project showing NFT API integration in a React app with TailwindCSS.
content.description: A hosted NFT project that demonstrates how to integrate an NFT API into a React app styled with TailwindCSS, showcasing multi-chain support across Ethereum, Solana, and Multichain. It introduces developers to the NFT API workflow and guides them to build a complete React front end, with instructor videos that walk through the integration steps. The project is open to community contributions and has substantial potential for scaling as it evolves to accommodate broader NFT data needs.
content.meta: NFT Explorer demonstrates NFT API integration in a React app with TailwindCSS. Discover NFT Explorer and other NFT Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
